    <id>http://arxiv.org/abs/2609.04658v1</id>
    <title>VizIt: A multi-view framework for exploring single-cell, spatial, and genetic data online</title>
    <updated>2026-09-04T02:40:47Z</updated>
    <link href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.04658v1" rel="alternate" type="text/html"/>
    <link href="https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.04658v1" rel="related" type="application/pdf" title="pdf"/>
    <summary>Multi-omic studies increasingly require data to be examined from complementary biological perspectives, yet interactive exploration remains fragmented across modalities and tools. We present VizIt, an open-source framework for multi-view exploration of single-cell and spatial transcriptomic, epigenomic and genetic data. VizIt connects gene-, cell type-, condition-, spatial-, genomic region- and variant-centered views, enabling seamless navigation across biological perspectives. We demonstrate VizIt through the Parkinson's Cell Atlas, a customizable interactive multi-omic resource.</summary>
